Water breaks and a useful reminder
The desk is glad to help just now
Travelers, keep your pet papers close and speak up early if anything changes.

Companion Animal Travel Desk needs prompt, respectful updates so we can keep companion travel smooth for everyone. If a crate, harness, vaccination note, or route detail looks off, tell the desk right away and we will help sort it out in plain language. That keeps the trip calm and helps Aurelia Skyways give steady support from check-in through arrival.

If you are bringing a pet along, use clear labels, steady handling, and a simple plan for food, water, and rest. Short, direct messages work best, and kind communication makes the whole process easier for staff and travelers alike. Layla Silva and Yara Khan would get the same straightforward help as anyone else, and Moose would be treated with the same care and attention.

For quick guidance, follow the desk's instructions as soon as you receive them and flag any concern before you leave for the airport. That is the fastest way to protect your pet's comfort and avoid last-minute trouble.

Please check with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you travel.
